studies.name: codec-v1
studies.disposition: count8ctz/count8unroll closed: small warm wins do not establish consistent cold gains and binaries grow. Later source review identifies the same missing reversed-limit guard in both old unsigned-length specializations. Old timings are ineligible for production qualification. Native-context snapshot saving is negligible; early 4 MiB screens are explicitly nonproduction surrogates.

studies.name: codec-v2-and-guarded-proof
studies.disposition: Original count16 is invalid: direct-header regression probes expose 768 traps and one wrong result for reversed limits; its ~3% warm component results cannot qualify the corrected binary. CStream64 is rejected with 72 tight-destination status regressions. New guarded binary passes correctness and awaits prospective complete-import run 46109596112; no guarded performance claim.
studies.timingScope: Original two-host component cohorts retain all warm/cold observations. Guarded receipts are correctness-only, not a timing rerun.

studies.name: direct-record-lengths

All losses and tails retained. Correctness/reach are promising but hosted replication run 46106878218 is still pending; no PR or complete-import gain.
